an10.14:1.1: [sāvatthiyaṃ] yassa kassaci bhikkhave bhikkhussa vā bhikkhuniyā vā pañca cetokhilā appahīnā pañca cetaso vinibandhā asamucchinnā, tassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati hāniyeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu no vuddhi.
an10.14:2.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu satthari kaṅkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati na sampasīdati,
an10.14:2.3: yo so bhikkhave bhikkhu sattharikaṅkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati na sampasīdati tassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya.
an10.14:2.4: yassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya evamassāyaṃ paṭhamo cetokhilo appahīno hoti.
an10.14:3.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu dhamme kaṅkhati …pe…
an10.14:3.5: sabrahmacārīsu kupito hoti anattamano āhatacitto khilajāto. tassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya.
an10.14:3.6: yassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya. evamassāyaṃ pañcamo cetokhilo appahīno hoti.
an10.14:4.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāmesu avītarāgo hoti avigatachando avigatapemo avigatapipāso avigatapariḷāho avigatataṇho.
an10.14:4.3: yo so bhikkhave bhikkhu kāmesu avītarāgo hoti, avigatachando avigatapemo avigatapipāso avigatapariḷāho avigatataṇho, tassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya.
an10.14:4.4: yassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya, evamassāyaṃ paṭhamo cetaso vinibandho asamucchinno hoti.
an10.14:5.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye avītarāgo hoti …pe…
an10.14:5.3: udarāvadehakaṃ bhuñjitvā seyyasukhaṃ phassasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ anuyutto viharati.
an10.14:5.4: aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ paṇidhāya brahmacariyaṃ carati ‘imināhaṃ sīlena vā vatena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā devo vā bhavissāmi devaññataro vāti.
an10.14:5.5: yo so bhikkhave bhikkhu aññataraṃ deva nikāyaṃ paṇidhāya brahmacariyaṃ carati imināhaṃ sīlena vā vatena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā devo vā bhavissāmi devaññataro vāti. tassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya.
an10.14:5.6: yassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya, evamassāyaṃ pañcamo cetaso vinibandhā asamucchinnā honti.
an10.14:6.1: yassa kassaci bhikkhave bhikkhussa vā bhikkhuniyā vā ime pañcacetokhilā appahīnā ime pañca cetaso vinibandhā asamucchinnā, tassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati hāniyeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu no vuddhi.
an10.14:7.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave kāḷapakkhe candassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati. hāyateva vaṇṇena, hāyati maṇḍalena, hāyati ābhāya, hāyati ārohapariṇāhena,
an10.14:7.2: emameva kho bhikkhave yassa kassaci bhikkhussa vā bhikkhuniyā vā ime pañca cetokhilā appahīnā, ime pañca cetaso vinibandhā asamucchinnā, tassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati hāniyeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu no vuddhi.
an10.14:8.1: yassa kassaci bhikkhave bhikkhussa vā bhikkhuniyā vā pañca cetokhilā pahīnā pañca cetaso vinibandhā samucchinnā tassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati, vuddhiyeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu no parihāni.
an10.14:9.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu satthari na kaṅkhati na vicikicchati, adhimuccati sampasīdati.
an10.14:9.3: yo so bhikkhave bhikkhu satthari na kaṅkhati na vicikicchati adhimuccati sampasīdati, tassa cittaṃ namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya.
an10.14:9.4: yassa cittaṃ namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya. evamassāyaṃ paṭhamo cetokhilo pahīno hoti.
an10.14:10.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu dhamme na kaṅkhati …pe…
an10.14:10.4: sabrahmacārīsu na kupito hoti attamano na āhatacitto na khilajāto,
an10.14:10.5: yo so bhikkhave bhikkhu sabrahmacārīsu na kupito hoti attamano na āhatacitto na khilajāto tassa
an10.14:10.6: cittaṃ namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya. evamassāyaṃ pañcamo cetokhilo pahīno hoti.
an10.14:11.1: katamassa pañca cetaso vinibandhā susamucchinnā honti:
an10.14:11.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāmesu vītarāgo hoti vigatacichando vigatapemo vigatapipāso vigatapariḷāho vigatataṇho.
an10.14:11.3: yo so bhikkhave bhikkhu kāmesu vītarāgo hoti vigatachando vigatapemo vigatapipāso vigatapariḷāho vigatataṇho, tassa
an10.14:11.4: cittaṃ namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya. evamassāyaṃ paṭhamo cetaso vinibandho susamucchinno hoti.
an10.14:12.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye vītarāgo hoti …pe…
an10.14:12.3: na yāvadatthaṃ, udarāvadehakaṃ bhuñjitvā seyyasukhaṃ passasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ anuyutto viharati.
an10.14:12.4: na aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ paṇidhāya brahmacariyaṃ carati: “imināhaṃ sīlena vā vatena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā devo vā bhavissāmi, devaññataro vā”ti.
an10.14:12.5: yo so bhikkhave bhikkhu na aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ paṇidhāya brahmacariyaṃ carati ‘imināhaṃ sīlena vā vatena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā devo vā bhavissāmi devaññataro vā’ ti. tassa cittaṃ namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya.
an10.14:12.6: yassa cittaṃ namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya evamassāyaṃ pañcamo cetaso vinibandho susamucchinno hoti.
an10.14:12.7: imassa pañca cetaso vinibandhā susamucchinnā honti.
an10.14:13.1: yassa kassaci bhikkhave bhikkhussa vā bhikkhuniyā vā ime pañcacetokhilā pahīnā ime pañcacetaso vinibandhā susamucchinnā tassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati vuddhiyeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu no parihāni.
an10.14:14.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave juṇhapakkhe candassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati, vaḍḍhateva vaṇṇena vaḍḍhati maṇḍalena vaḍḍhati ābhāya vaḍḍhati ārohapariṇāhena.
an10.14:14.2: evameva kho bhikkhave yassa kassaci bhikkhussa vā bhikkhuniyā vā ime pañcacetokhilā pahīnā ime pañcacetaso vinibandhā susamucchinno, tassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati vuddhiyeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu no parihānīti.
